dataFlow.step: User submits password in POST /api/signup or /api/login request body
requestLog middleware fires on response finish; for /api/signup and /api/login paths, fields.body = req.body is set (includes raw password) and written via logger.debug
logger.debug serialises the log record (including body.password) as a JSON line appended to logs/app.log
Password is hashed with bcrypt before INSERT; only pw_hash is stored in the users table — raw password never written to SQLite
createUser inserts pw_hash (bcrypt digest) into users.pw_hash — raw password absent from DB
LOG_LEVEL defaults to 'debug', so logger.debug calls are not filtered out
